t: This is South Africa House, a building in London designed by Herbert Baker. Baker was an English architect, and he is remembered as the dominant force in South African architecture. That makes him a fitting choice for this building. He developed a neo-classical style that interacted theatrically with the landscape and was meant to project imperial strength and permanence. He was the most prominent and prolific architect of his generation, and here you can see his work in the heart of London.
